endorsements.quote: Moving forward, the surgical community must prioritize rigorous validation, inclusive dataset development, transparent governance, and continuous monitoring to ensure that AI is implemented responsibly.

unlisted_practices: Involve clinicians directly in the design and oversight of AI systems.
Develop inclusive, diverse datasets for surgical AI development.
Adhere to established reporting guidelines such as TRIPOD when developing surgical AI models.
Share datasets publicly to support reproducibility and transparency of surgical AI models.

screen.reason: Editorial/point-counterpoint analysis debating the pros and cons of AI in surgical care and offering broad governance/implementation perspectives.
